entities.summary: Edmond Bordeaux Szekely was a Hungarian philologist/linguist, philosopher, psychologist and natural living enthusiast. Szekely authored The Essene Gospel of Peace, which he alleged to have translated from an ancient text he discovered in the 1920s. Scholars consider the text a forgery. He was grandson of Sándor Székely, poet and Unitarian bishop of Kolozsvár and descendant of Sándor Kőrösi Csoma.
